author: vivirancy
name: Verification
install_msg:
Thank you for installing Verification!
Run `[p]verifyset settings` to begin, then `[p]verifyset toggle` once configured.
short: Protect your community from unwanted bots by enforcing verification for new members.
description: Gate new members behind an image captcha delivered through a button panel, with configurable roles to add and remove on success. Captchas and code entry are private to each member, so the verification channel can stay locked.
end_user_data_statement: This cog temporarily stores the Discord user ID, a generated verification code, an attempt count, an expiry timestamp, and a lockout flag for members currently undergoing verification. This data is deleted when verification completes, when a moderator resets the member, or when the member leaves the server. Separately, every verification outcome (passed, failed attempt, expired, locked out) is recorded as a modlog case naming the member, through vivi-cogs/ModLog when installed and Red's core modlog otherwise. Those cases are retained by whichever modlog recorded them and are not removed when the member leaves.
